book.name: Rom
book.title: ROM Pol ata Rom kaptam-ami sukon dola kuyinsa kaata ko

content: Israel iyo God ami minlo tem unemin disa keliwa, God alta bokoya-lom, Kiili tituun-kup tabin unang tunum kelip o, ke-bisa disa kaami sang kaata ko
Nak-tunum kusal kipyo, nami aket ma fukunbi kaali, atin ti nalmi kayaak Israel ili God ayo asuk yim-buulama no, kala-lomdi suunkup God ami kanolin sang kaata naalin-kup ke-bam laabi.

Kemin, nali talalu Israel kii itamsi kemin, imi sang ayo weng kaa ku-fatap-daayokomi. Ili titil-fak-daa God ami daang bakaalum o, kebip. Lale, ili babon-bamdipla, ilmi aket fukunin kusnum kaata, kuluu-lomdip kaata God ami daang bakaalup kayi kalbip o.

Kanola ti God ayo unang tunum imi bokoya-lomda: Kipni kukup mafak kaami uluum ayo disa keyilula, tituun-kup tabin unang tunum kelip o kalin kaami kukup kaa utamup disa yo, kala-lomdip kaa nulmi kukup kaata ti, tituun-kup o kala-lomdip kaata-kup kutal-fuku-bom biisip. Kemin, ili Yesus ami lak duulip God ata bokoya-lomda: Ibi tituun-kup tabin unang tunum kelin o, kalin kaami kukup kaa kuluulamup disa yo, ke-biisip.
Nokol kaa kaal-kelum. Moses ami Lo uyo Kraist ata nolaya tiikasu. Kemin, unang tunum alik Kraist ami lak duulin iyo God ayo bokoya-lomda: Ibi tituun-kup tabin unang tunum kelip o, ken-umba no.
God ayo unang tunum alik im-taldang almi miit tem tiilon o, keba kaami sang kaata ko
Moses ayo sukon uyo dola-lomdale, unang tunum imi lo fukulip God ata bokoya-lomda: Ibi tituun-kup tabin unang tunum o yakan-kaamin kaami sang ayo boko-lomda:

content.text: Unang tunum kii kanta Lo kutiisi kaa talalu kutal-fukulip namti, kiita tiin kawang sinik kaa kuluulokomip o,

content: kalsa.

Kemin ale, God ami Sukon Tem uyo tunum God ami lak duula no, kalale, bokola-lom: Kabi tituun-kup tabin tunum kelap kayi kalin kaami sang kaata boko-lomdu: Kaltapni aket tem-kup boko-lomdap: Nali tam abiil tikiin abali asuk tolon o, kemin daa yo, kalsu. Weng kabak-ami miit kaali, tunum kaa dok kano-somdaya tam Kraist ayo dap-taldaak daa-lom ami weng uyo weng san-kaa-mokoma disa yo, kalsu.

Kemin, aa ti kuno Sukon Tem ma kuuli boko-lomdu: Kabi boko-lomdap: Nali daak sakbal am abali asuk tolon o, kemin daa yo, kala weng kaami miit kaali, tunum ali kalok kano-lomdaya din sakbal imi abip kaa din-ilomda Kraist ayo dap-taltam-daalaya, ami weng kaa weng san-kaa-mokoma disa yo kalsu.
Lale, God ami Sukon Tem kabak-ali kanimin o, kalsu? Kaali boko-lomdu:

content.text: God ami weng ayo kapni diim kawu bombuule, kapni bon tem kawu bombuule, kapni aket tem kawu bombuu no,

content: kalsu. Kemin, God ami weng kaali, numi Kraist ami lak duu-yaamin kaami sang kaata, unang tunum imi bakayila-laabup namti kaa bombuu.

Kanola kabi weng ku-fatap-daa, boko-lom: Yesus kaali nami God ale, nami Kamokim ke kesa no, kalale, kapni aket tem ayo talalu utamawa, Fan God ayo Yesus kaa kom tem kawu dafose no kala, kanum bokolap namti, kaata fan God ayo tam-taldang-daalokoma no.

Nuli aket fuku-daalupla yi, Ali tifaneng o, ke-bulupla, God ayo bokoya-lomda: Kipni ban kemin kaami maan ayo disa keyulula, tituun-kup tabin unang tunum kelip o, kal-bom ale, numi Yesus ami lak dakaamin kaami sang kaata, nulmi bon tem kawu baka-bulupla, God ayo nuli im-taldang tii-bam kem-laaba.
God ami Sukon Tem ma kabak akal Kraist ami sang ayo boko-lomdu:

content.text: Dok kanolin unang tunum iyo ma ami lak duuliwa kawu, ali imi daang ukuyilala, fatom duk-duulokomip disa yo,

content: kalsu.

Kemin, Juda so, tunum miit ma ma iso, ili God ata kukup maakup kaata-kup kukaayila-laaba. Kemin, ata alik numi Kamokim akal ti maakup kemin, kanta ami naan-bam beten kamaala-laabip namti, ali olenin dukum-kup kamayin-bamda dong dakaayim-bam kem-laaba.
Kaami sang kaa God ami Sukon Tem kabaku boko-lomdu:

content.text: Kawanita Dukum ayo naan-bam beten kamaalip namti, ili im-taldang almi miit tem daalokoma no,

content: kalsu ko.

Lale, God almi weng kukaayin tunum ma yim-baala tilin disa kelip namti, ili kalok kano-lom God ami weng ayo Juda unang tunum imi kukaayokomip daa; tunum maakup ma tal God ami weng uyo kukaayin daa ke-lokoma kaa, kalok no-som God ami weng kaa weng sanokomip disa; aa, ami weng uyo weng selin disa kelip namti, kaa dok kano utamipla, Fan, Yesus ali God o kalin disa kelip kaa! Kemin kaata ili utamipla, Fan Yesus kaa God o, kalin disa ke dok kano-lom naan-daalokomip disa; la, God ali fan almi weng kukaayin tunum iyo fokola tal-ilomdip God ami weng kukaayin-bilipla, Juda kayaak iyo weng san-kaamsip. Sukon Tem kaami sang ayo boko-lomdu: Tunum iyo weng tangbal kulii-tal bokola namti, atin kukup tangbal namti kabe no, kalsu ko.
Israel yaapkan ili ma God ami weng tangbal ayo ma kulii-tabasip disa yo kalsip kiimi sang kaata ko

Kata, Israel ili ti alik maakup God ami weng tambal ayo kulii-tabasip disa; kabak-ami sang kaali, Aisaya ayo boko-lomda: Dukum kapyo. Kanta numi weng kaa, ti faneng o, kalbip? Kiili, yaapkan disa yo, kalsa.

Nuli utamuwa yi, God ami okok kemin tunum ita taba-lom God ami weng numi bakayinbip ayo Kraist ami sang o, kalalup weng san-kaa-bulupla, weng kaata numi aket tem kufuyim-bulula, Kraist ami lak kaali, dakan-umbup o, kala utamup.
Weng ma dik-daalokomi. God ami weng tambal kaa ma Israel kasel iyo weng san-kan-umbip disa yoko? Ayo, weng san-kaan-umbip. Ultap kemin, God ami Sukon Tem uyo boko-lomdu:

content.text: God ami weng ayo yak abip ma ma kiiyo, alik yakyak una-bulu am bokon kala dik-daa kulaasu kaami unang tunum iyo weng san-kan-umbip o, kala

content: kanum bokosu.

Lale, asuk weng kaa maso ma dik-daalokomi. Israel kayaak ili weng kala talalu weng sansip disa ema? Ayo, ili dotu weng sansip. Kamala kalawaali kayak kayak yakal ti utam kebip kamasi kaali, Moses ami Sukon Tem usiik God ayo Israel kasel imi bokoya-lomda:

content.text: Ibi boko-lomdip, Nuli tunum miit tangbal o, kalbip. Lale, nali ibi yim-buulokomi disa; unang tunum iip maakup maakup ita ma yim-buulila, kipni aket ayo mafak ilula, kukup tangbal ma imi kukaayokomi kaali, ibi nen-bamdip tunum miit utamsip disa ita ma yim-buulokomi kaa, ibi aket atul kamayokomip o,

content: kalsa.
Aisaya ali Israel imi atul kaata, itam-suun-daasa disa kemin, tunum miit kusnum imi sang kaata-kup kufola-lom God ami weng uyo boko-lomda:

content.text: Tunum miit kusnum iyo nitamum o, kalalip fenbip disa. Yale, ili nita-mokomip ale, aa ili aptum kusal imi nami sang kaa ma dik-daalin dinim. La, nali imi diim kawu fatap-nila iyo nita-mokomip o,

content: kalsa.
La, Israel kasel imi sang ma kaali God ayo boko-lomda:

content.text: Nali unang tunum iyo weng kuyang saak tii-bamdip titil-kup tabasip iyo, Tal nami nak-tunum kusal kep-niwa yo, kalalila naayin-bili, atan tal-una, kayoop tal-una-kem-tabasu. Lale, iyo kulaasip o,

content: kalsa no.
